items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I practically didn't know their names too good, you know.

ctx.x: Abadeez. That name sounds muted, but I can't place where it was.

Oh, here's something I want to ask you, Eddie. I noticed where 25s used to be, before they laid the new sidewalk there, they had a name in the sidewalk, J-N-O-T Lala, outside the big 25s there. Was that his name, the man that ran 25s? J-N-O-T Lala. Yes, J-N-O-T Lala. I think the first called him J-N-O-T Lala.
Well, they had a couple of brothers of them Lala. J-N-O-T Lala, Pete Lala. I practically didn't know their names too good, you know.
